_comment: Overlay applied by tools/make_handin.py on config/setup_windows.json: generic window centres and half-widths.

springs_front.source: midpoint and half-width of the spring options (the midpoint itself is not an option)

springs_rear.source: midpoint and half-width of the spring options (the midpoint itself is not an option)

damper_bump_ls_fl.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_bump_ls_fr.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_bump_ls_rl.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_bump_ls_rr.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_rebound_ls_fl.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_rebound_ls_fr.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_rebound_ls_rl.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

damper_rebound_ls_rr.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-20 click range

ride_height_front.source: standard and its lower window edge

diff_position.source: midpoint and half-width of the 1-5 range

toe_front.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

toe_rear.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

camber_fl.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

camber_fr.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

camber_rl.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

camber_rr.source: midpoint and half-width of the value range

tc_lat.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-12 range

tc_lon.source: midpoint and half-width of the 0-12 range

splitter_offset.source: default and half-width of the value range

wing_position.note: Stored as the option label, not the angle, so no numeric window.
